scope: SPP, BPA, non-RTO West; official-source assessment and LL registers plus utility/PUC records and evidence gaps. No Site modifications.

bpa.scope: All BPA Connection Type LL rows including historical energized, withdrawn, line, mixed network/load and unspecified purpose. Summer/Winter Interconnection Service MW are preserved, not recast as net-new requested load.

keyLimitations: SPP unique assessment IDs are historical published assessment identities, not physical facilities or current pending customers.
SPP detailed report MW are modeled study-load values, not necessarily net-new requested or contracted demand. Do not sum them.
BPA LL includes lines, substations, transfers, withdrawals and energized projects. All 458 rows are excluded from additive customer MW.
BPA workbook contains no public study-report hyperlinks on any of its 458 LL rows.
Western docket records may be amendments or cover several legal entities. They are evidence observations, not necessarily new customers.
No complete current high-load customer denominator established for any western utility in reviewed public material. NV Energy 50-project denominator is a specific 2026 IRP forecast scope.
Black Hills April 29 presentation verified through official web PDF extraction; local download timed out. SD PUC public documents downloaded successfully.
preservation: All SPP assessment history rows retain original URL, index URL, publication date, workbook sheet/row and raw fields. BPA records retain all 40 raw source fields. Research raw directory contains the original source workbooks and retrieved detailed reports.
